Retry and dead-letter counts include both gateway-service-v1 and notification-service-v1 groups.
consumer.retries does not count the immediate redelivery after a failed dead-letter publish; that outage shows as a missing dead_letter increment and error handler logs.
processed and end-to-end samples are per consumer attempt; two concurrent deliveries of one event can both be counted.
